saw_lines: Sunscreen and hair serums get re-bought on a routine, so a first-time buyer picks the brand with the better first deal.
So the sale is won in line one, where a shopper decides whether the first order is worth trying.
Your site offers up to 35% off, yet 0 of 25 ads mention it. Put the 35% offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Oct 2026
points: The site offers up to 35% off, yet 0 of 25 ads mention percent off or any offer, so new buyers have no reason to act. Put the 35% offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

0 of 25 copy ads carry a proof number, and the 96% stat sits in a single carousel. Buyers meet claims with no count behind them. Collect one real count, such as reviews, and open three new ads with it.

Your 25 copy ads use 15 different openings and the biggest leads only 4, so no story repeats enough to be recognised. Pick the two clearest openings and build the next batch from those two, three ads each.

3 ads have run 60+ days, so they are proven winners. Build three variations of the oldest one, changing only the first line and the offer, and keep the body that already runs. The message that held up stays intact.
